question.text: Unclaimed dividends and matured deposits must remain unpaid for how many years before they are transferred to the IEPF?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook says unpaid or unclaimed dividends, matured debentures and deposits, application and call money due for refund, and the interest accrued on these amounts are transferred to the IEPF after they remain unpaid and unclaimed for seven years. That makes option D correct. The Trap: Options A, B, and C (3, 5, and 10 years) are plausible-sounding figures that do not match the seven-year threshold the workbook applies to these unclaimed corporate amounts. Candidates who recall a different timeline from another context can be drawn to the wrong figure. Note: The workbook uses the same seven-year threshold for the various categories of unclaimed corporate amounts listed in this chapter, so the cut-off for dividends and matured deposits is the same one used for the other listed sources.
